answer: The design leans on reputation decay for idle identities, published publicly on failure. The velvet lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the lagoon is where a second reviewer recomputes them. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. By the kernel of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up.
